verses.text: T'a yewial slajwi uke' k'ual yochkan winhaj Aarón t'a yopisio chi', ix awtaj winh yet' heb' yuninal yet' heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' yuj winhaj Moisés.

Ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Aarón chi': Ik'kot junok nok' kelem wakax yik tz'och nok' silab'il yuj a mul yet' junok nok' ch'ak kalnel, haton nok' malaj jab'ok spaltail. Tza nhustz'a smasanil silab'il uuj, tzak'och nok' t'a yichanh Jehová.

Alpax t'a heb' ketisraelal to syik'kot junok nok' mam chiwa heb' silab'il yuj smul. Syik'anpaxkot junok nok' kelem wakax heb' yet' junok nok' kalnel, yuj snhusjitz'a nok' smasanil silab'il, jun ab'il sk'inal junjun nok', malajokab' jab'ok spaltail nok'.

Syik'anpaxkot junok nok' wakax heb' yet' junok nok' ch'ak kalnel smiljicham t'a yichanh Jehová silab'il yik sch'oxan sjunk'olal heb' yet'ok. Syik'anpaxkot junok ofrenda heb' t'a tas swaji, kalab'il yet' aceite, yujto ol sch'ox sb'a Jehová t'ayex tiknaik, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yik'ankot heb' t'a yichanh mantiado masanil tastak ix chekji yik'kot yuj winhaj Moisés chi'. Masanil chonhab' ix jawi molan, ix och linhjab' heb' t'a yichanh Jehová.
Haxo ix yalan winhaj Moisés chi' t'a heb' icha tik: Haton wal juntzanh tik schek Jehová he k'ulej yik wach' ol sch'ox wal stzikikial t'ayex, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalanxi winh t'a winhaj Aarón chi': Nitzkot a b'a t'a slak'anil altar tik, tzak'an nok' nok' silab'ok yuj a mul yet' nok' silab' snhusjitz'a smasanil. Icha chi' ol aj yak'ji lajwok a mul. Tzak'anpax nok' silab' yuj yak'ji lajwok ko mul a onh israel onh tik, icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix jawi winhaj Aarón t'a slak'anil altar chi', ix smilancham nok' kelem wakax ix yak' winh silab'il yuj smul chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix japax heb' yuninal winh yet' schik'il nok' silab' chi', ix yak'anem yiximal sk'ab' winh t'a skal chik' chi', ix sukanoch winh t'a sch'ak altar chi'. Haxo jab'okxo chik' ixto kan chi', ix sekkanem winh t'a yich altar chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix snhusantz'a smasanil xepual nok' winh t'a yib'anh altar yet' pax stut nok' yet' xepual ayoch t'a yib'anh seyub' nok', haton nok' silab' yuj mul, icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Haxo pax sb'ak'chil nok' yet' stz'umal, ix nhusjitz'a t'a spatikel campamento.
Ix smilanpaxcham nok' silab' winhaj Aarón chi', nok' snhusjitz'a smasanil, haxo heb' yuninal winh ix ik'ankot schik'il nok', ix stzikanoch winh t'a schanhil pak'anh altar.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'anpaxkot sjolom nok' heb' yet' nok' ix xikchajb'at chi', ix snhusantz'a winh t'a yib'anh altar chi'.
Ix maxchaj nok' yol sk'ool yet' nok' yok, ix snhusanpaxtz'a winh t'a yib'anh altar chi', t'a yib'anh nok' wanxo stz'a chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an silab' winh yuj heb' yetchonhab'. Ix yik'ankot nok' chiwa winh, haton nok' silab' tz'ak'ji yuj smul heb' yetchonhab' chi'. Ix smilancham nok' winh, ix yak'an nok' winh silab'il icha ix yutej yak'an nok' b'ab'el chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an junxo nok' silab' winh to stz'a smasanil icha sleyal.
Ix yak'anpax ofrenda winh t'a tas swaji. Ix yik'b'at jun b'echanh ixim harina winh, ix snhusantz'a winh t'a yib'anh altar yet' silab' snhusjitz'a t'a junjun k'inhib'alil.

Ix yak'anpax nok' wakax winh yet' nok' ch'ak kalnel ix yik'kot heb' yetchonhab' chi' silab'il yuj sch'oxan sjunk'olal heb' yet' Dios. Ha heb' yuninal winh ix ik'ankot schik'il nok', haxo winh ix tzikanoch t'a schanhil pak'anh altar chi'.
Ix yak'anpax xepual nok' wakax heb' yet' xepual nok' ch'ak kalnel chi', haton xepu' ayoch t'a snhe nok', t'a nok' yol sk'ool yet' t'a nok' stut yet' xepu' ayoch t'a yib'anh seyub' nok'.
Junnhej ix aj nok' xepu' chi' yet' nok' snhi' sk'ool. Haxo winhaj Aarón ix nhusantz'a nok' xepual chi' t'a yib'anh altar.
Haxo pax nok' snhisk'ol chi' yet' nok' xub' t'a swach', tonhej ix b'akhjiek' t'a yichanh Jehová, icha ix aj yalan winhaj Moisés chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yik'anchaanh sk'ab' winhaj Aarón chi', ix yalan wach' lolonel winh t'a yib'anh heb' yetchonhab' chi'. Ayik toxo ix lajwi snhusantz'a silab' winh yuj mul yet' silab' snhusjitz'a smasanil yet' silab' yik sch'oxan sjunk'olal yet' Dios, ix emixta winh b'aj ay altar chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix och winhaj Moisés yet' winh t'a mantiado b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová. Haxo ix elta heb' winh, ix yalan wach' lolonel heb' winh t'a yib'anh heb' yetchonhab' chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix sch'oxan stzikikial Jehová t'a masanil heb' israel chi'.

Ix elta k'ak' t'a yichanh Jehová chi', ix snhusantz'a nok' silab' yet' xepual nok' ayk'e t'a yib'anh altar, ix tz'ab'at smasanil. Ha ix yilan masanil jun chi' heb' chonhab' chi', ix el yaw heb' t'a tzalajk'olal, ix em nhojjab' heb', ix emk'och snanhal sat heb' t'a sat lu'um.
